sloka: आजगाम ततो वाली हत्वा तम् दानवर्षभः ।ततो अहम् अददाम् राज्यम् गौरवात् भय यंत्रितः ॥४-४६-१०॥
transliteration: ājagāma tato vālī hatvā tam dānavarṣabhaḥ ।tato aham adadām rājyam gauravāt bhaya yaṁtritaḥ ॥4-46-10॥

translations.english: Then Vali, having slain that bull among danavas, returned; and I, constrained by fear yet out of respect, gave the kingdom back to him.
